_readme: All wording for 'share a question and see if your friend matched' (#92). Edit text here, no code change needed. {line} in a share message is replaced by the line the player just saw. 'adult' is used on every route except Kids & Family; 'kids' is used on Kids & Family routes. Keep kids copy kid-appropriate. 'ui' holds the button labels and result icons of the share and match screens.

heading.matched: You matched the person who sent this
heading.different: You and the person who sent this picked differently
heading.asked: You picked one. Tell them so they can see if you match.

matched: Great minds… or equally questionable ones.
A match. Your friendship just got suspiciously easy.
Same pick. Now one of you has to be the weird one next time.
You're either in sync or in trouble.
Twins separated at birth, or just equally unhinged?
Same choice. Nobody check the reasoning.
A match. Don't let it go to your heads.
Same pick. Somebody's copying, and we won't ask who.
You agree. Enjoy it, it won't last.
different: Someone has some explaining to do.
Different picks. One of you is wrong, and it isn't you.
You split. Time for a strongly worded text.
Opposite choices. Dinner just got awkward.
Not a match. Prepare your closing argument.
Different picks. Who's the weird one? Don't answer yet.
You picked differently. Go ahead, judge them.

share.first_after: I picked one. Pick yours and let's see if we match.
share.first_before: Would you rather…? I want to know what you'd pick.
share.tell_asked: I answered. Open this to see if we match.
